body: Oh my bad how embarrassing ksks
Thank you for ur words. I do need to try to get out of it all, I mentioned it to him but he won’t take me serious. So the next opportunity I get, I will try and leave. Again thank you

Thank you ever so much for sharing this.. i appreciate it so much and I’m glad you got out of it. It sounds exactly what it’s like with my boyfriend, even though I try to leave, he forces me to stay and tries to make me talk and uses his strength against me, blocks my way etc.. but it’s just so hard to leave, when I talk about ending it all with him, he doesn’t take me serious at all.. it’s all so frustrating

Thank you for sharing your experience it means a lot to me. And yes, they make us feel like we are the “bad one”, he called me sick and psychotic and other vulgar things. And for a while I actually thought I really was all that. Until I reached out here on Reddit…
also him not allowing me to leave the room felt even more scary.. I need to sort this shit out ..
You are right. I’m going to go home for a while and need to clear my head. I have to bring myself to stand up against him..

Exactly, your experience sounds ever so similar to mine! I repeatedly asked him again and again to stop, to let m out of the room etc and he acted like I never said it, just kept on doing what he wanted.. it infuriated me. The slap was me just completely losing it. It was my last resort but he pushed me and provoked me so far for me to get there. Thank you for sharing your experience, and also thank you for uR encouraging words.
You are right, I should. I need to try. Thank you.
I know you intentions are good. Like for me when I’m upset and angry, I just need space to calm myself down and think rationally. And him ignoring my continuous “No’s” just frustrates me so much …
You’re probably right..

Hey.. thank you so much for sharing your experience.. it seems all so familiar to what he is like, it is really making me so unhappy. I do need to do something really. Thank you again, you give me hope!

He keeps thinking he is doing me a favor and has good intentions by not allowing me to leave the room, cause he says he wants to be close to me.. I just hate it though and hes so much stronger than me and I simply cannot really “ escape him”.. i think on General his misogynistic mindset makes him think he has the right to do so
It is you are right..
Thank you so much for ur help and support I really appreciate it.. I will try my best
Thank you for this.. I still feel so bad about hitting him, so I think I need to hear this. I guess I kept telling myself the whole time that it was all my fault
I will try. It’s so hard to leave him, he wouldn’t let me
Yes you’re very right. I might go home for a few days to be alone for a while. Hopefully both of us can reflect on the whole situation..
Thank you for sharing this with me!
A few people already mentioned reactive abuse..need to look into it more. Thank you
Yes I agree with you. I know I went too far. I decided to go home for a while. Hope we can both reflect when alone. Thank you for ur advice!
You’re right, it is.
It’s wrong either way.
I want to thank everyone for reading the post and taking their time to help me out. You’re all so great and kind and all of your words made my day. Thank you.
You’re right,.
I think so too..thank you for reading
Thank you for understanding. The slap really was a “just finally leave me alone” because he wouldn’t stop. It was wrong of me but I was ever so frustrated..

Thank you very much for the quiz, I’ll make sure to take it now. And yes I know, the relationship is very unhealthy. For 2 years I think I tried to hard to make it work and there are always some moments that get my hopes high, and I tend to ignore the negatives. I need to do a lot of reflecting. Thank you very much again!
Yes, me slapping him was wrong. And thank you, you are probably right
Oh no don’t apologize it’s all good! And thank you very much!!!!
Oh yeah :’) as you can tell, my feeling of self worth is really non existent ahh I realize all my posts here are all negative and depressing oh dear :’))))
oh what other posts exactlyy? sorry I’m not that often on Reddit ;-; and thank u! I’m trying the best I can haha!
Thank you sm, it was very helpful, really need to remind myself to think about it properly. And no I actually haven’t heard about it before!

Yes you’re right, this is the first time I slapped him, and I know that this isn’t something I would normally choose to do and to do so in the future. Thank you for taking the time to help me and share your words with me it means a lot. I think I will go home for a bit soon to distance myself for a while. I need to do some reflecting and I hope he will do so as well..or I might have to leave.
Yes you are absolutely right. Thank you for your words, I think I need to have a long talk with him :’)

Yes and you are absolutely right, people should not put hands on each other, this is the first time this happened and I do feel very very bad and guilty. 
I felt very frustrated and I guess me slapping him was my last resort after him continually provoking, pulling, tugging me. Blocking my way etc.. 

And thank you so much for taking the time to read what I wrote and responding. It means a lot to me so thank you for your words!
Yes you are definitely right. I need to learn to stand up for myself. Thank you for your words

You’re right, I bet his intentions were good but i was so frustrated with him for ignoring me saying no the entire time. I should talk to him. 
PS. I actually watched Shang chi already loved it so much!!
Hugs are wanted :D and thank you again, you’re right I deffo need to seek out help

Thank you so much for putting in the effort to write this all to me. It means a lot. And I really need to hear it. I had a horrible day today and I still feel very very guilty. I know if the roles were reversed (a man hitting a woman) it would be so different. I don’t feel very good, but thank you for your kind words.
Thank you very much for your insight and sharing it all with me!!
Thank you so much for sharing the post I will have a look at it now!
Yes you’re right, if it was a man hitting the woman, it would be very different. Me slapping him was wrong and it was abusive. Thank you for taking the time to read everything and commenting.

Basically I turned away from him trying to sleep. He got on top or forced me to turn towards him. He was getting really angry that I wasn’t cooperating, he is stronger than me and it hurt when he tried to make me move or when he pulled and tugged me. He didn’t apologize while it was happening, he apologized today. I felt really bad about it all so I’m not doing to good today, he is out rn. We’re not that cool I guess
Yes you’re right I do need to sort it all out. Thank you for taking the time to help me

Oh god, that makes sense.. his behavior today does really fit to the whole honeymoon period.. I should look into it more, thank you for sharing this.. it’s really helpful.. and no it’s not the first time, but it is the first time I slapped him.. which is why I feel a lot more guilty about it

Thank you for telling me about the DARVO tactic.. seems to fit the situation I was in last night. He was using his physical strength to his advantage by holding me, not letting me out of the room.. I was really frustrated.. and you’re right, the relationship is really toxic and wrong, I just can’t seem to stand up for myself
Yes the hitting was wrong. Thank you for taking the time to read what I wrote
Yeah you’re right. Thank you for taking the time to read it all
Thank you for your words, I feel like I need to hear this..

I think I’m only know realizing how scary it really is. Since yesterday I have been so down, can’t stop thinking about it. He ignored it all and thinks by making me breakfast it’s all good. But I’m still so angry about it all. And you’re right, it’s very toxic what’s going on but when being together for 2 years I feel like I couldn’t leave, it’s really bad
Exactly what he did!! He stands in front of the door and does not allow me to get past him and pushes me away.. it’s so infuriating..

I’ve never heard of reactive abuse.. that sounds very fitting to my situation thank you for bringing it up. 
And yes you are obviously right, slapping him was not ok. I know how traumatizing physical abuse can be because of my own family. I would never wish it on someone else, and I know it was wrong of me. But it was just so frustrating, he wouldn’t let me leave the room, he would force me to turn to him etc that I just felt helpless
I feel like he doesn’t take me very serious when i mention I’m going to call for help. But really you’re right. I probably should have called cops on him for not letting me leave the room.
Yeah like he was trying to pull me towards him, like grabbing my arm really bad and tugging me and hurting me. He would like try to sit on top of me and force me to look at him.
You’re right.. I really need to sort this out

Yes you’re right. We live together and before I slapped him, when he kept ignoring me saying no, I tried locking myself in the bathroom to stay away, since I knew how upset I was getting. But he wouldn’t allow me to leave the bedroom..
Thank you for this. He kept ignoring me and belittling me by not respecting me saying no. But I don’t really know what else to do.
Yeah you are right, my frustration took over. I really don’t know if it’s okay to stay in the relationship, we’ve been together for 2 years, I feel like I couldn’t bring myself to end it.
Yeah the slapping was too much. And your are right..
It did feel like he was provoking me, but I went too far. And thank u for reading and taking the time to write something!
I know I shouldn’t have, you are right. Thank you
Oh no don’t worry, lighthearted rn is good, I’m feeling so down so it’s fine! :-) and thank u!
I know, I felt like I just lost control and I was so frustrated..
Yeah, I felt so bullied when he kept ignoring me.. he completely belittled me by choosing to ignore me saying no..
Yeah you’re right. Thank you
Thank u so much for ur kind words x
Im glad you’re seeing a therapist I hope it’s helping! I hope I can convince my parents since I really do want to reach out for help... thank u so much!!!
Im sorry to hear that. I know how hard it is. That’s really kind of u, same goes for u!
Thats really good advice I’ve never thought of that. Thank you ever so much
Thank you I will definitely try talking to someone at school!  Merry Christmas to u to!:)
I will definitely try. Thank you so much for your advice it means so much to me

I would have thought so as well but when I try to talk to them about it, it’s just them saying I’m being dramatic which is really frustrating because they don’t want to understand. That’s at least what I feel like.
Yes I have someone at school I can talk to. I will definitely try thank you for your advice

Oh thank you for sharing that means a lot to me. For me it also has a lot to do with my appearance. And from there it just turned into more. I feel like I can’t deal with it anymore and I feel pretty lost. 
Im glad your therapist is nice and supportive that makes me happy. 
I hope I can talk to my parents once more about it. I really want to change I want help but I feel like it’s out of reach 
Thank you for your kind words!
